id: title:fivestarspicy:capture gemini reasoning and group scan traces in llma

review.posthog_relevance: Adds compatibility and observability support for Gemini SDK thought-summary blocks and trace ID handling in LLM analytics, without changing runtime behavior.
review.reason: The chunk contains three unrelated PRs: P1.F1 and P1.F2 address Gemini SDK compatibility and compatibility rules for message normalization; P1.F3 adds trace ID handling. None change runtime behavior, and no tier 2 or 3 systemic improvements are demonstrated. Tier 1 is assigned for narrow, localised compatibility and test additions.
review.uncertainty: No tier 2 or 3 systemic improvements demonstrated; compatibility and observability support does not establish tier 2 or 3. No tier 2 or 3 systemic improvements demonstrated; compatibility and observability support does not establish tier 2 or 3.

observations.limitations: This chunk is split across 4 unrelated PRs. P1.F1 and P1.F2 are AI observability frontend; P1.F3 and P1.F4 are replay vision backend. No shared group. P1.F3 and P1.F4 are not compatible with P1.F1 and P1.F2. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a test for Gemini SDK thought-summary blocks alongside typed function blocks, expecting normalized messages to preserve the thought as assistant thinking and keep the sibling tool call as a typed tool call.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression test for message normalization compatibility with Gemini thought-summary blocks; does not change runtime behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a compat_array.yaml rule to emit tool calls when a bare function block is reached, after a sibling block (e.g., thinking) knocks the message off the envelope rule.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a compatibility rule to preserve tool-call structure when message envelope is broken by a sibling block; does not change runtime behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds uuid4 import and its use in _scan_trace_id, returning a fresh UUID when snapshot_override is set, otherwise using observation_id.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds trace_id parameter and its use in LLM analytics; does not change runtime behavior.
